scope: API 36 emulator responsiveness and crash-safety during repeated primary navigation
evidence: Phase14LongevityDeviceTest repeated Home, Profiles, Settings, and Home navigation for 50 cycles.
The exact Phase 14 device manifest completed 28 of 28 tests in 122.873 seconds.
The device gate reported no application crash, ANR, zero-test false pass, or missing expected test.
limitations: An emulator navigation loop is not long-duration CPU, memory, thermal, battery, radio, sleep, or process-pressure evidence.
Weak physical devices, OEM firmware, foldables, tablets, cellular handover, and multi-hour endurance remain UNVERIFIED.
